note: The folder a clone of each address lands in. For a spelling the clone rewrites (owner/repo, host/owner/repo, a page pasted from a GitHub host) it is the repository's name; otherwise it is git's own rule for the text as typed. Each case is read with `github_hosts`, the hosts read as GitHub's besides github.com (github.com alone when absent), shaped as the bootstrap document carries them. Read by `the_shared_clone_folder_name_fixture_holds` in crates/dux-core/src/clone_project.rs and by cloneDirName.test.ts in the web UI, which check that the address gives `name` (null for an address with no usable name).
